title: c-VEP dataset from Thielen et al. (2015)
description: A 64-channel EEG dataset of a broad-band visually evoked potential (BBVEP) brain-computer interface, recorded from 12 healthy participants using a 6x6 matrix speller. Cells were flashed with modulated Gold codes, and participants performed copy-spelling in three runs of 36 trials. The data support reconvolution-based template prediction and code-modulated VEP (c-VEP) classification, with reported online accuracy of about 86%.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Biosemi ActiveTwo system (64 active electrodes, 2048 Hz, CMS/DRL reference). Participants attended target cells of a 6x6 speller stimulated with pseudo-random modulated Gold codes (126 bits, 4.2 s trials). Data were downsampled to 360 Hz, detrended, common-average referenced and spectrally filtered. Classification used template matching with canonical correlation analysis.
